title: Adversarial Multiplicity: Cherry-Picked Models and the Limits of Disclosure
summary: Learned risk predictors support a retrospective wildfire-attribution sensitivity analysis; the reported aggregate estimates vary by model selection and are not causal proof. The result is reported in the arXiv preprint. Affiliation was not stated in the reviewed material. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
